findings.description: Nicola Domenichelli died on 29 June 1981 in Rosario de la Frontera, Salta, Argentina; his death was registered there the next day. The identity is established on an index-only route accepted by a senior genealogist: the tree's Nicola and his Italian birth record share the same parents across two independent indexes, and the death record ties to that Nicola on indexed facts (name, 1897 birth year, Rosario de la Frontera, widower after his wife's 1970 death).
